csv_project_name: Impact Fee Study and Ordinance Update
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Parkland (City) is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced consultants to prepare a comprehensive Impact Fee Study and corresponding Impact Fee Ordinance update. The study must be legally defensible, consistent with the Florida Impact Fee Act, and reflect best practices in municipal impact fee programs. The resulting fee schedules must reasonably and proportionally relate to the impacts of new development on municipal services. Contractor shall provide all supervision, labor, materials, tools, equipment, and necessary essentials for the completion of this contract, in the manner specified in this solicitation, in accordance with the terms, conditions, scope of services, specifications, and requirements of this competitive solicitation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Impact Fee Study and Ordinance Update
short_description: Consulting services for a municipal impact fee study and ordinance update.
project_scope: Preparation of a comprehensive municipal impact fee study and corresponding impact fee ordinance update for the City of Parkland. The study must be legally defensible, comply with the Florida Impact Fee Act, reflect best practices in municipal impact fee programs, and establish fee schedules proportionate to the impacts of new development on municipal services.
services: Consulting services including impact fee study preparation, ordinance update, civil engineering input, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a planning/consulting assignment, not a structural or building design project.
- Scope focuses on impact fees, ordinance update, and municipal policy compliance.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural engineering component is indicated.
- Falls under feasibility/planning-oriented services, which are not a target area for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction works are tendered and no construction budget is stated. The notice concerns a consulting study and ordinance update only.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the notice. As this is a policy and planning consultancy rather than structural engineering design, an sbp fee estimate is not meaningful from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced consultants are requested. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
